newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London down, market cautious.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London down, market cautious.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were down on Thursday as the market adopted a wait-and-see attitude ahead of budget news from Tokyo, traders said.

The Nikkei 50 index of leading shares traded in London was 1.71 points or 0.12 percent above Wednesday's London close at 1,448.17, after the Tokyo Nikkei 225 index ended 30.64 points or 0.16 firmer at 19,021.56.
"We've seen a little profit-taking in some of the banks and hi-tech stocks, but it's been one of the quietest days we've had in a long time," one trader said.
"The markets are slowing down. We're waiting for concrete information for the Tokyo government on budgets and how they're going to spend the money."
Investors were also waiting to see what direction the U.S. dollar, currently trading around the 121 yen level, would take, he said.
"There's a definite wait and see attitude at the moment, and it's led to inactivity."
